statement.task: Halstead volume/density: NOT ported as standalone verdicts. The AST operator/operand measures stay reachable on Structure (volume/halstead/halstead_density) but are ungated — volume is a code-size proxy strongly correlated with the complexity family (cyclomatic/cognitive/sloc), and difficulty/density is a weak standalone gate. Revisit only if a non-size-correlated use emerges.
